You just have to accept it, Lyn.''"
"''Stop calling me that.''"
"''But that is who you are.''"
"''There is no way out, is there?''"
"''That's what the Empire wants you to think."|Barriss Offee and Lyn Rakish|{{TOTE|The Way Out}}}} The '''Fourth Sister''', formerly known as '''Lyn Rakish''', was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Nogratu]] [[Gender|female]] member of the [[Inquisitorius]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. Once a [[Jedi]] herself, the Fourth Sister recruited fallen Jedi [[Barriss Offee]] into the Inquisitorius, although Offee eventually abandoned the group while on a [[Mission to a rocky planet|mission]] with the Fourth Sister to find a rogue [[Unidentified human Jedi|Jedi]]. The Fourth Sister also participated in the [[hunt for Obi-Wan]] Kenobi in [[9 BBY]], joining fellow Inquisitors to search for the [[Jedi Master]] on the [[planet]]s [[Daiyu]] and [[Mapuzo]] and failing to prevent Kenobi's [[Rescue of Princess Leia (9 BBY)|escape]] from the [[Fortress Inquisitorius]]. Eventually, the Fourth Sister located and confronted Offee, who encouraged her to leave the Empire behind after the Fourth Sister severely wounded her. During the [[Prisoner|imprisonment]] of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Thom Hudd]], the Fourth Sister was impersonated by Rebel [[Commander]] [[Lina Graf]], who was able to rescue Hudd. ==Biography== ===Fallen Jedi=== {{Quote|Who are they?''"
"''Inquisitors. Many were Jedi who turned to the dark side. Now, they hunt their own kind.|Leia Organa and Obi-Wan Kenobi, upon seeing Fourth Sister and Fifth Brother|{{Kenobi|Part II}}}} Lyn Rakish{{TOTE|Devoted}} was a [[Nogratu]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a [[Jedi]] of the [[Jedi Order]]. At some point, she met fellow Jedi [[Barriss Offee]], who later became disillusioned with the Jedi Order and [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar|bombed]] a [[Imperial Palace|Jedi temple]] hangar. Offee was arrested at the [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ|Republic Center for Military Operations]] for her crimes.{{TCW|The Wrong Jedi}} After [[Order 66]], she fell to the [[dark side of the Force]] and willingly became the Fourth Sister in the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Inquisitorius]], who served the [[Sith]] as an extension of [[Darth Sidious]] and [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] will.[[Darth Vader (2017) 6|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 6]] ===Recruiting Barriss Offee=== {{Quote|Lyn?''"
"''I don't go by that name anymore. Things have changed.|Barriss Offee and the Fourth Sister|}} [[File:FourthSisterNoArmor-SWCT.png|thumb|200px|left|The Fourth Sister before she dawned her Inquisitor armor]] Rakish, by then known as the Fourth Sister, visited Barriss Offee at the [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ]] accompanied by two [[Imperial shock trooper|Imperial clone shock troopers]] and offered her a chance to join the newly established Empire's Inquisitorius. Offee recognized her as "Lyn," to which Rakish replied that she did not go by that name anymore. She informed Offee that the visit was not on behalf of the [[Jedi Council]], before stating that Offee may have been correct when she accused the Jedi of murder and treason. Rakish told Offee that the Jedi had tried to assassinate [[Supreme Chancellor|Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. She then offered Offee a place in the Inquisitorius. Rakish escorted Offee to a ''[[Scythe (Phi-class)|Scythe]]'' shuttle, which flew them to the [[Fortress Inquisitorius]] on the ocean moon [[Nur]]. Shortly after, she tested [[Dante]] and witnessed him fight Offee. Offee killed Dante, leading to Offee officially joining the Inquisitors, as Rakish gave her a [[helmet]]. Soon after, the Fourth Sister, along with Offee, the [[Eleventh Brother]], and the [[Marrok|First Brother]] entered a room in [[Fortress Inquisitorius]]. They all knelt to [[The Grand Inquisitor]], who introduced them to their new master, to whom he also knelt: the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]. Offee became an Inquisitor as a result of her slaying Dante, but she became disillusioned with the cruelty of the Empire and abandoned the Inquisitorius and pushed the Fourth Sister with the Force while they chased a [[Unidentified human Jedi|Jedi]].{{TOTE|Realization}} ===Hunting Obi-Wan Kenobi=== {{Quote|He could be anywhere.|The Fourth Sister on Kenobi's location|}} [[File:FourthSister_and_GrandInquisitor_Part_2.jpg|thumb|right|290px|The Fourth Sister during the mission to Daiyu]] In [[9 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Part III]]" to [[9 BBY]]. after the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] hired [[Vect Nokru]] and his mercenaries to kidnap the [[Alderaanian]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and bring her to [[Daiyu]] in hopes that [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] would be contacted by Leia's adoptive father, Imperial [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa]], to rescue her. The Fourth Sister and the [[Fifth Brother]] accompanied [[the Grand Inquisitor]] to capture Kenobi. Once they met with the Third Sister on Daiyu, the Grand Inquisitor chastised her for kidnapping a senator's daughter and dismissed her from the mission. After the Inquisitors secured the city, the Fourth Sister showed the Grand Inquisitor a bounty-hunter alert advertising a bounty placed on Kenobi's head, leading the Grand Inquisitor to deduce that the Third Sister had acted behind his back again. She later went to examine a crowd of civilians. [[File:FourthSisterAndFifthBrother-PartIII.png|thumb|left|290px|Upon discovering Kenobi's whereabouts, the Fourth Sister was present at Fortress Inquisitorius to coordinate military deployment in Mapuzo.]] After the supposed death of the Grand Inquisitor on Daiyu, the Fourth Sister was present at Fortress Inquisitorius along with the Fifth Brother when the Third Sister arrived to inform them of the location of Kenobi. The Fourth Sister claimed that the Jedi Master could be anywhere, but the Third Sister demanded the [[probe droid]]s to be sent out to pinpoint Obi-Wan's locations as she got orders from Darth Vader himself. The Inquisitors later had another meeting at the fortress where they confirmed that Kenobi was at [[Mapuzo]], a mining planet on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]]. The Fourth Sister then ordered a group of [[Imperial officer]]s to gather their [[stormtrooper]]s and shut down every port at the planet. The Fourth Sister and her fellow Inquisitors arrived along with Darth Vader at a nearby settlement on Mapuzo. While the [[Sith Lord]] terrorized civilians in order to draw Kenobi out, the Inquisitors had the task of sweeping the town and searching for others. After Vader briefly dueled Obi-Wan on a quarry where the Jedi Master managed to escape, the Fourth Sister informed the Fifth Brother that their new orders were to sweep the planet. [[File:WhatDefeatWouldBring-OWKPartIV.png|thumb|right|290px|The Fourth Sister was present when Lord Vader reprimanded the Third Sister for her failure.]] The Fourth Sister was present along with the Fifth Brother during the [[Rescue of Princess Leia (9 BBY)|infiltration]] of the Fortress Inquisitorius by Obi-Wan Kenobi, though they failed to prevent his escape. Later, she and a pleased Fifth Brother witnessed Darth Vader's rage against the Third Sister because of her apparent failure and the Jedi’s seeming success in penetrating and escaping the Fortress, but the Sith spared her life when she told him it was in reality part of her plan to track Leia and the Jedi by inserting a restraining bolt on Leia’s droid [[L0-LA59]].{{Kenobi|Part IV}} ===A way out=== {{Quote|I am gonna get you out of here.|Rakish, to Offee|{{TOTE|The Way Out}}}} [[File:BarrissFourthSister-TWO.png|thumb|left|300px|The Fourth Sister confronts Barriss Offee.]] While continuing to serve the Inquisitorius, the Fourth Sister went on a mission hunting a Force-sensitive infant named [[Micah]] and his family. Her search brought her to an ice planet, where she discovered her quarry being sheltered by Offee. The Fourth Sister remarked on the irony that she found Offee when the Inquisitorius had almost given up searching for her. She then attacked Offee, who easily evaded her strikes, even holding back her lightsaber with the Force. Realizing Offee was stalling her as the family and Offee's attendants made it into a nearby cave system, the Fourth Sister demanded she stand aside. Offee freely permitted her to follow, but forewarned that if she entered the cave, she would not come out. Dismissing her warning, the Fourth Sister vowed to return for Offee once she had dealt with the child.{{TOTE|The Way Out}} Venturing into the labyrinth, the Fourth Sister scoured the tunnels, but her quarry reached Offee's starship and fled the planet before she could reach them. With her target having escaped and becoming lost in the tunnels, the Fourth Sister furiously slashed at an ice wall, before hearing Offee calling out, offering to show her the way out if she lowered her weapon. The Fourth Sister expressed hesitancy, knowing what the Empire would do to her if she returned empty handed, leading Barriss to remark that fear was not her ally, but her master. The Fourth Sister then struck at the walls in frustration before accidentally striking Barriss, who was approaching her with open arms, through the abdomen. Having been stabbed by the lightsaber, Barriss began to die, and slumped to the ground. Overcome with remorse, the Fourth Sister caught Offee, who offered forgiveness and encouraged the Fourth Sister to leave behind her Inquisitor persona and become Rakish again. Offee insisted that there was both a way out of the cave and a way out of the Empire for her. After leaving her Inquisitor lightsaber behind and with Offee's guidance, the Fourth Sister navigated out of the cave while carrying Offee's body.{{TOTE|The Way Out}} ===Impersonation=== {{Quote|So, as you can see, Inquisitor… simply being a lackey of the Emperor isn't enough…you must ''earn'' your respect within these walls. If indeed you are an Inquisitor at all!|Vaneé to Lina Graf, who was impersonating the Fourth Sister|[[Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle 5|''Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle'' 5]]}} [[File:LinaGrafAsFourthSister-ReturnToVadersCastle4.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Lina Graf impersonated the Fourth Sister on Mustafar.]] The fate of the Fourth Sister was ultimately unknown.{{EncyclopediaCite|Darth Maul and Other Followers of the Dark Side}} At some point following a [[Fact-finding mission to the Outer Rim|mission to the Outer Rim]] by members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], the Fourth Sister lost her [[armor]] to Rebel Alliance [[Commander]] [[Lina Graf]]. Other than the fact that the Inquisitor's armor was in Graf's possession, nothing was known about the fate of the Fourth Sister to [[The galaxy|the wider galaxy]]. Graf, wearing the Fourth Sister's armor, impersonated her and infiltrated [[Fortress Vader]] on [[Mustafar]] where Rebel [[Lieutenant]] [[Thom Hudd]] was being held [[prisoner]] by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] [[aide]], [[Vaneé]]. After talking and fighting with the Fourth Sister, Vaneé realized that it was not her, but that it was Graf. Vaneé told her that he knew because she was not carrying a [[lightsaber]], and briefly defeated her. Graf, however, regained the upper hand and along with Hudd, escaped Mustafar. ==Personality and traits== The Fourth Sister hunted down serving Jedi mercilessly.{{Topps|set=2023 Topps Finest Star Wars|cardname=Fourth Sister|link=https://www.comc.com/Cards/Star_Wars/2023/Topps_Finest_Star_Wars_-_Base_-_Refractor/FN-42/The_Fourth_Sister/24685083}} She respected the Grand Inquisitor's wishes, having a no-nonsense attitude when it came to abiding orders or giving them.''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' Like most Inquisitors, she was terrified of Lord Vader, quickly stepping back when he angrily arrived to punish Third Sister for her failure. According to the Thirteenth Sister, the Fourth Sister's mind seemed to always be elsewhere, making her unavailable for sparring sessions with her fellow Inquisitors. ==Powers and abilities== [[File:FourthSister-SWCT.png|thumb|left|180px|The Fourth Sister was Force-sensitive and carried a double-bladed spinning lightsaber.]] As an Inquisitor, the Fourth Sister was [[Force-sensitive]]. She was a skilled lightsaber duelist and could manipulate her environment through [[Telekinesis]]. Despite her skill, [[Barriss Offee]] noted that her anger made her predictable. ==Equipment== {{Quote|How did you know?''"
"''That you were a fake? An ''Inquisitor'' without a lightsaber? You must think me a fool…|Lina Graf and Vaneé, the former of whom was impersonating the Fourth Sister|}} The Fourth Sister was equipped with her own dark-[[color]]ed Inquisitor uniform, and carried a [[Double-bladed spinning lightsaber|double-bladed spinning]] [[Fourth Sister's hilt|lightsaber]]. When impersonating Fourth Sister, Lina Graf wore a [[helmet]] that had a red [[Macrobinocular viewplate|T-shaped visor]] with wings on the side of the helmet. However, she lacked a lightsaber like the Fourth Sister carried, leading Vaneé to realize she was an impostor.[[Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle 4|''Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle'' 4]] ==Behind the scenes== [[File:FourthSister-ToppsChoice2025.png|right|thumb|261x261px|The Fourth Sister depicted in ''Tales of the Empire''.]] The Fourth Sister was first mentioned via impersonation in the [[Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle 4|fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, which was written by [[Cavan Scott]], illustrated by [[Francesco Francavilla]], and released on [[October 23]], [[2019]].{{Comixology|url=Star-Wars-Adventures-Return-to-Vader-s-Castle-4-of-5/digital-comic/796206|text=Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle #4|nolive=1}} Although she was not named in the comic, Scott later revealed that the impersonated Inquisitor was dubbed Fourth Sister in the comic's script.{{Twitter|cavanscott|status/1187032072545849345|[[Cavan Scott]]|quote=In the script she is described as the Fourth Sister...|archivefile=File:Fourth_Sister_confirmation.png|backup=https://web.archive.org/web/20191023193420/https://twitter.com/cavanscott/status/1187032072545849345}} She was later formally identified as such in the [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] reference booklet "[[Darth Maul and Other Followers of the Dark Side]]," published by [[De Agostini]] on [[July 13]], [[2021]].{{DeAgostini|url=libros-comics/enciclopedia-star-wars|text=Star Wars Encyclopedia}} The actual Fourth Sister first appeared in "[[Part II]]" of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'', in which she was portrayed by [[Rya Kihlstedt]], which was first announced on the [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] website.{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=press|url=disney-plus/obi-wan-kenobi/images?image_id=obi_wan_kenobi_online_trailer2_uhd_r709f_stills_220427_c496450f|text=Obi-Wan Kenobi Images}} Kihlstedt later reprised the role, voicing Lyn Rakish/the Fourth Sister for the animated [[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire|''Tales of the Empire'']] series of shorts. {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan
